verdicts.argument: The specification text 'Wärmedämmplatten liefern und vollflächig verlegen' does not contain any information regarding insulation thickness or thermal conductivity class, so the bidder is correct that these mandatory details for energy certification are missing.
The description 'Boden gemäß Baugrubenprofil lösen und ausheben' does not specify the homogeneous area (Homogenbereich) as required by DIN 18300, leaving the distribution of ground risks unclear.

The phrase 'Abdichtung gemäß geltenden technischen Regeln herstellen' is generic and does not specify the water impact class or the specific standard (DIN 18533), so the finding of a missing mandatory specification is valid.
